summary: Diana Shipping Inc. filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report, the non-US equivalent of a US Form 8-K) disclosing a press release dated September 21, 2026, announcing that a wholly-owned subsidiary entered a time charter with Dai An Ocean Shipping for the Ultramax m/v DSI Polaris at a gross rate of US$18,000 per day, minus 5.00% commission, running from September 25, 2026 until minimum May 1, 2028 and maximum June 30, 2028, replacing an existing Cargill charter at US$12,250 per day. This is an ordinary commercial charter contract, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms apply.
